title: Card 2: fetcher sirf khabar laata, Kafka me daalta. Worker apni speed se DB + Redis me likhta. Ek url ek hi baar

callouts.red: Fetcher hi seedha DB me likhe?
callouts.green: 1000 source ek-ek karke: source A atka to B se Z sab line me peeche

callouts.red: Dobara likhna Bloom filter se roko?
callouts.green: Galat: Bloom DB se alag hai. Likhne ke beech crash = khabar feed me do baar

callouts.red: 1000 khabar ek saath Kafka me aayi
callouts.green: Line lambi hui, gira kuch nahi: Kafka disk pe rakhta, worker apni speed se

callouts.red: Worker ne DB me likha, Kafka ko "padh liya" bolne se pehle gira
callouts.green: Khabar dobara aayi, par DB khud rokta: url UNIQUE ("pehle se hai to kuch mat karo")

callouts.red: Source pe kuch naya hi nahi? Pehle poochho "badla kya?" (ETag / Last-Modified), nahi to download hi mat karo.
callouts.green: SQS chalega? Chal jaata, par Kafka me search / analytics apne group se wahi khabar padh lete

kyun: Fetcher sirf khabar laata aur Kafka me daalta. Worker apni speed se DB + Redis me likhta. Laane me der ya bheed ho tab bhi Arpan ki feed khulti, bas thodi purani
peeche: card 1 me feed Redis me pehle se bani
ab: Arpan ki feed me khabar 20 minute purani
agla: ab khabar taazi. Par 8 baje sab ek saath aa gaye (card 3)
